experiment_data.hypothesis: If type confusability is a causal driver of extraction errors, then renaming high-BCS type pairs to reduce embedding similarity (while preserving semantic equivalence) should improve accuracy on high-BCS batches. This tests the causal direction: SCS → confusion, not merely correlation. If treatment (renamed) accuracy on previously-high-BCS batches improves significantly over control (original names), confusability is actionable via schema design.
